name: english-debug
description: The English patch (config/patch/english.json) plus the DEBUG BUILD additions of config/patch/debug.json in ONE module: Konami's step overlay / debug text renderers / OPTION hidden scenes forced on (pokes D_800B9710 = 1, D_800BA280 = 8), the generated 4-bpp debug font (debug_font_load hook), and the L2+R2 scene selector (dbg_game_main through the game_main call site). The debug sources are appended to the English module.  Since the English module grew (2026-10-10) the two no longer fit the release kanji block together: this debug-only profile extends the reclaimed glyph region 0x400 bytes earlier and links whole input sections into retail library code that nothing can reach (config/patch/free_regions.json from tools/patch/free_regions.py, re-proven dead at every build; runtime evidence: config/patch/english-poison.json + soak_test.py). The release region stays unchanged; the debug kanji subset takes what is left. Output: build/patch/english-debug/.

region.note: debug-only: extend 0x600 bytes further (0x400 on 2026-10-10, +0x100 on 2026-11-06 after the Sunday-cell frame, +0x100 on 2026-11-07 after the mouse-button icons) into reclaimed kanji glyphs so English glyph-per-cell + debug font still fit; release keeps its original region

hooks.note: retail uploads RAM 0x801F0020 (nothing ever puts a font there on the retail disc); the hook uploads the generated 4bpp font to the same VRAM rect (704,480 64x32 words)

callsites.note: _main's frame loop `jal game_main`: game_main's first two words are a hoisted now_step load that falls into the body, so a head trampoline is impossible; the call site is redirected and dbg_game_main calls the untouched retail game_main

pokes.note: D_800B9710 Konami debug-display flag (.data, retail 0); retail sets it only when the memory-card file BISLPS-00065F exists at OPTION boot (tools/patch/debug_memcard.py makes such a card for the plain English disc); the module re-asserts it every frame
D_800BA280 'pn' debug text page (retail 0): the three renderers draw only when >= 4
